items.title: No accuracy estimate in these clinics
items.whyItMatters: Sensitivity varies across clinic populations (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Estimate sensitivity in each clinic with enough urgent messages.

items.title: Reference standard reliability
items.opportunity: Written definition, calibration and third-clinician adjudication.

items.title: Messages in other languages
items.whyItMatters: Sensitivity was 71 percent for such messages (claim c2), and clinic C has the most.
items.opportunity: Report sensitivity by language; keep clinic C in the sample if possible.

items.title: Time saved is not accuracy
items.whyItMatters: Workload gains do not justify missed urgent messages.
items.opportunity: Report time saved as secondary and misses as a balancing measure.

reevaluation: A multi-site accuracy study with language-specific results is the right next step.
